title: Winter and Smile
author: Paloma Kavanagh
blurb: Orsen Winterbourne, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
